rows.corpus_definition: To look at two things to see how they differ.
rows.example_en: Compare this photo with the old one.

rows.corpus_definition: An event where people try to be better than others.
rows.example_en: She entered a dance competition last week.

rows.corpus_definition: Very difficult to understand because it has many parts.
rows.example_en: This math problem is too complicated for me.

rows.corpus_definition: To direct all your mental effort on one thing.
rows.example_en: It is hard to concentrate with this noise.

rows.corpus_definition: to admit that you did something wrong or bad
rows.example_en: She confessed that she had broken the vase.

rows.corpus_definition: Feeling sure about your own skills or success.
rows.example_en: She has the confidence to speak in public.

rows.corpus_definition: Feeling sure about your own skills or success.
rows.example_en: He feels confident about passing the test.

rows.corpus_definition: To think two things are the same by mistake.
rows.example_en: Do not confuse the twins with each other.

rows.corpus_definition: to take control of a place or people by using force
rows.example_en: Alexander the Great managed to conquer many powerful nations.

rows.corpus_definition: to make someone feel better when they are sad or upset
rows.example_en: She tried to console her friend after the bad news.
